claims.assertion: Mari Swa says biological bodies limit perception to the material world, while astral realms contain entities that can affect living people.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: Mari Swa says low-astral entities attach to places and may react to visitors; she treats subtle emotional responses as possible signs of their influence.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says entities may not always perceive visitors either.

claims.assertion: Mari Swa recommends connecting with Source and imagining a bright energetic shield, which she says focused creative attention manifests and helps maintain higher vibration.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: This is her proposed protection practice.

coverage_gaps: Aura and orb descriptions; her account of how place memories and collective interpretation shape perceived vibrations.
